notes.text: The identified preface includes all four figures in the exact order and the same second-generation rubric. Heilprin has another occurrence of this source in the Modi’in entry.

The preface gives Eliezer of Modi’in where the abbreviated Heilprin text is translated Elazar, and continues “and many others”. The Ammihud spelling is direct evidence for Heilprin’s source, not independent historical identification.
This is Heilprin’s report of his unsuccessful search, distinct from the exact match in the post-Talmudic preface.
